flows: Legacy bookmark keys (yovinx-saved, tallyvein-saved, quilsted-saved, buidlspur-saved, citevra-saved, attestora-saved) migrate into settiva-saved, keep their row state and leave the legacy record in place
Identity, canonical URL, paper theme colour, mark, wordmark, tagline and no-writes notice ship; the terminal skeleton is absent
Selecting an entry replaces the index with an in-flow dossier, focuses its heading and returns focus to the index
Dossier scope, contribution, review and gate copy all render; sample writes are disabled and the section action focuses the evidence field
Search, four topic filters, four standing filters, four sort choices and Reset drive the index and recover from an empty result
Keep, toast Undo, dismiss, reload persistence, the Saved page and its empty state all behave
Index, Saved, My briefs and Guide are full pages; Guide replaces the index, keeps the masthead, carries the FAQ and has one marker per row
Draft sheet: invalid URL and zero reward are rejected with focus management, review echoes the exact amount, the draft downloads as a Settiva markdown file, and the draft survives close and reopen
The wallet gate stays gated at every entry point and exposes no enabled write
Skip link leads the tab order to an existing target; ArrowDown/End and Enter drive the entry index
Below 900 px the dossier stays in flow with focus return, and navigation is a full-screen contents menu that Escape closes
Six viewports fit without sideways scroll, keep the Georgia reading voice and carry the sample gate into the colophon
